decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that stayed visible from 2023 to 2024 and fits the firm's stated strategic direction, it is likely performing at or near aspiration and worth continued support.

Although its presentation seems less prominent in 2024 than at launch, it remains on the website, is close to core salami capabilities, and would likely be kept unless retailer pull clearly falls below aspiration.

This 2024 organic extension is closely tied to the established assortment and strategic organic expansion, so boundedly rational management would usually give it more time before reallocating resources.

A new 2024 organic line with several variants and its own page matches the firm's move toward broader organic and ingredient-conscious offerings, making continued retention likely while results are still being learned.

This 2024 herb-coated organic salami fits existing know-how but looks more niche than the firm's core lines, so it is somewhat more exposed to being cut if first-year sales fall short, though uncertainty still argues for keeping it for now.
